_about: Public-domain George Sexton (1825-1898), English secularist lecturer who renounced infidelity and was ordained, for the Word Hoard: Theistic Problems, Christianity and Secularism, Light in the Cloud (his reasons for renouncing infidelity), History's Testimony to Christ, The Doctrine of Immortality as taught in the Old Testament, Biblical Difficulties Dispelled, The Folly of Atheism, a review of the Moody and Sankey revival, and A Portraiture of Mormonism. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 107 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

gsexton-mormonism: A portraiture of Mormonism (London : W. Strange, 1849)

gsexton-biblical-difficulties: Biblical difficulties dispelled : being an answer to queries respecting so-called discrepancies in Scripture, misunderstood and misinterpreted texts, etc., etc (Toronto : W. Briggs, 1885)

gsexton-folly-atheism: The folly of atheism (Philadelphia : M.E. Book Room ; Toronto : W. Briggs, 1895)
